What better way to celebrate the new year than with a tourney on the amazing [[TB5]] FROST maps created by {{player|bps|flag=se}}!

'''AYE AYE Monthly Cup #2''' is a one-day double bracket duel tournament which will take place on Saturday 28th January 2023 at 19:00 UTC. It will have an upper and lower division and will take place on [[TB5]] FROST!

==Format==
* Double Elimination (will switch to round robin if there aren't many players)
* BO1
* Map pool: [[dm2frost]], [[dm4frost]], [[dm6frost]], [[aerowalkfrost]] [[ztndm3frost]] (rnd, player1 drop, player2 drop, player1 drop, player2 drop, play)

==Results==

==Sign Up==
This tourney will be managed using Challonge. To sign up for the lower bracket, click [https://challonge.com/ayeaye2lb here]. To sign up for the upper bracket, click [https://challonge.com/ayeaye2ub here].
